title: DNA extraction from frozen whole blood
author: Luise A. Seeker
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.i6cchaw
materials: DNA extraction from frozen whole blood
Using DNeasy Blood and Tissue Kit (Qiagen): Spin columns

steps.title: Prepare reagents and equipment
steps.instruction: Read the Important Notes (page 15) of the DNeasy Blood & Tissue Kit handbook. Warm Buffer AL to 56 °C if a precipitate is present. Prepare working solutions of Buffer AW1 and Buffer AW2 by adding the ethanol (96–100 %) amount indicated on the bottle. Pre‑heat a water bath to 56 °C for later incubations. Set the microcentrifuge to operate at room temperature (15–25 °C). Ensure the vortexer is set for pulse‑vortexing of 5–10 s.

steps.title: Thaw whole blood samples
steps.instruction: Place frozen whole‑blood tubes at 4 °C and allow them to thaw slowly for approximately 2–3 h (1–5 ml volume).

steps.title: Lyse red blood cells
steps.instruction: Dispense 900 µl RBC Lysis Solution into a 2 ml microcentrifuge tube. Add 300 µl whole blood, invert the tube 10 times to mix, then incubate at room temperature (15–25 °C) for 5 min, inverting at least once during incubation.

steps.title: Pellet white blood cells
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tube for 30 s at 14 000 × g (room temperature) to pellet the white blood cells.

steps.title: Remove supernatant and resuspend pellet
steps.instruction: Using a 1 ml pipette, carefully remove the supernatant, leaving ~10 µl residual liquid with the pellet. Vortex the tube vigorously (pulse‑vortex 5–10 s) to resuspend the pellet in the residual liquid.

steps.title: Resuspend pellet in PBS
steps.instruction: Pipette the cell pellet up and down and add 90 µl PBS, vortex until the pellet is completely dispersed.

steps.title: Add Proteinase K and RNase A
steps.instruction: Add 30 µl Proteinase K and 4 µl RNase A (100 mg ml⁻¹) to the suspension, then incubate at room temperature (15–25 °C) for 2 min.

steps.title: Add Buffer AL and incubate
steps.instruction: Add 300 µl Buffer AL (no ethanol) to the mixture, vortex thoroughly (pulse‑vortex 5–10 s), and incubate in the 56 °C water bath for 10 min. After incubation, vortex for 10 s and incubate an additional 10 min at 56 °C.

steps.title: Add ethanol and mix
steps.instruction: Add 200 µl ethanol (96–100 %) to the sample, vortex thoroughly (pulse‑vortex 5–10 s) to obtain a homogeneous solution.

steps.title: Transfer to spin column and centrifuge
steps.instruction: Transfer the entire mixture to a DNeasy Mini spin column placed in a 2 ml collection tube. Centrifuge at 8800 rpm for 1 min (room temperature). Discard the flow‑through and collection tube. If the sample was prepared in duplicate, repeat this transfer with the second duplicate on the same spin column before proceeding.

steps.title: Wash column with Buffer AW1
steps.instruction: Place the spin column in a new 2 ml microcentrifuge tube (not provided), add 300 µl Buffer AW1, invert the tube 5 times and roll it with your fingers 5 times, then centrifuge at 8800 rpm for 1 min (room temperature). Discard flow‑through and collection tube.

steps.title: Wash and dry column with Buffer AW2
steps.instruction: Place the spin column in a new 2 ml collection tube (provided), add 300 µl Buffer AW2, invert 5 times and roll 5 times, then centrifuge at 14 000 rpm (≈20 000 × g) for 3 min (room temperature) to dry the membrane. Discard flow‑through and collection tube.

steps.title: Elute DNA with Buffer AE
steps.instruction: Place the spin column in a clean 1.5 ml microcentrifuge tube (not provided). Pipet 100 µl warm Buffer AE (pre‑heated at 56 °C) onto the membrane, incubate at 56 °C for 10 min (heat block to avoid condensation), then centrifuge at 8800 rpm for 1 min to elute DNA.

steps.title: Optional second elution or duplicate handling
steps.instruction: If the sample was prepared in duplicate, perform a second elution: add 50 µl warm Buffer AE, incubate at 56 °C for 5 min, and centrifuge at 8800 rpm for 1 min. If a total of >200 µl Buffer AE is required, use a new 1.5 ml tube for the second elution to prevent the silica membrane from contacting the flow‑through.
